Hello

Yes, that is correct. The ₦30,000 is the processing/service fee charged by our third party agent in Nigeria for the manual payout method. It is separate from the payout amount and is required before the agent processes the payment.
Am I the one paying that. Or you would deduct it from my payment

Yes, you would need to pay the ₦30,000 service fee separately to the third party agent. It cannot be deducted from your payout because the agent requires the fee separately for processing and documentation.  Regarding your friend, she chose not to pay the required fee and referred to the service as a scam. We take allegations of fraud seriously and do not tolerate false accusations.  For transparency, our records show over 112 successful manual payouts and 401 automatic payouts to date.

We understand your concern. The ₦30,000 fee was not mentioned earlier because it does not apply to automatic payouts.  The automatic payment system determines whether a transfer can be processed based on the receiving bank’s risk and payment policies. When an automatic payout cannot be completed, we use the manual payout method through our third party agent.  The ₦30,000 service fee applies only to this manual method, which is why you are being informed about it now.
